text: VBET was founded in 2003 by Vigen and Vahe Badalyan, whom SoftConstruct's leadership page lists as its co-founders (alongside a Head of VBET Group). UK filings for VBET SPORTS LIMITED (company 10392319) name both brothers, Armenian and resident in Armenia, as persons with significant control, each holding more than 25% but not more than 50% of shares and voting rights.
